```sql
WITH lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id,
           ol.variant_id,
           sum(ol.quantity)         AS quantity,
           sum(ol.line_total_cents) AS revenue_cents
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.variant_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       count(DISTINCT l.order_id)  AS order_count,
       sum(l.quantity)             AS quantity,
       sum(l.revenue_cents)        AS revenue_cents,
       count(DISTINCT pv.id)       AS variant_count
  FROM lines l
  JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = l.variant_id::uuid
  JOIN products p          ON p.id = pv.product_id
 GROUP BY p.id
 ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De orderregels worden eerst per order en variant-string samengevoegd. Daardoor gebeuren de `::uuid`-cast en de joins op minder rijen, terwijl de sommen en de distinct-tellingen gelijk blijven. De cast laat ik bewust staan, omdat `pv.id::text = ol.variant_id` niet equivalent is (hoofdletters, notatie zonder streepjes, foutgedrag bij ongeldige strings). Groeperen op alleen de primaire sleutel `p.id` geeft hetzelfde resultaat met een smallere groepeersleutel.
